notes.title: Glitch War 1.1 Update
notes.content:
First off thank you to everyone who has played and given feedback! This project has been amazing and I hope that all of these updates and fixes make the game that much better!

I am planning on keeping this alive so there may be more updates in the future, most of it depends on you and your feedback! I have started on my next project as well if you want to stay up to date on that check out my twitter: @codez333

Thank you again for supporting me and helping make this and future games a reality!

Update 1.1.0 (1/19/2021)
New:
[list]
[*]If a unit is ahead of you in a different lane you can now jump behind them!!! (Game changer!)
[*]Added Steam achievements!!
[*]Added corresponding achievements into the game.
[*]Added Fishing, Mining, and Digging spots that give rewards when you find them and have the corresponding ability!
[*]All units are sorted now so they appear behind each other correctly.
[*]Added more particle effects!
[/list]

Improved:
[list]
[*]Improved how collisions between units work.
[*]Improved and updated the pixel perfect camera making the game look a little better.
[*]Improved the cooldown on special attacks so units wouldn't spam them.
[*]Levels start a little more quickly so you don't need to wait as long.
[*]Changed tutorial level slightly to cover new mechanic of jumping behind units.
[*]Buffed Priestess can now damage enemies and even beat bosses.
[*]Debuffed Alchemist so that only 3 minitours can be on the field at once.
[*]Improved unit selection to swap units position instead of duplicating them.
[*]Added reset to unit selection to start from scratch.
[*]After a level is completed all gold will be collected automatically!
[/list]


Fixed:
[list]
[*]Music wouldn't mute correctly between level changes.
[*]Music wouldn't update correctly between level changes.
[*]Fix arenas bringing you to new levels.
[*]Pack tactics was not showing on all ally units that had the ability.
[*]Some health bars would not display correctly.
[*]Getting knocked back too far when dead.
[*]Gold count wasn't updating correctly when buying things.
[*]Fixed snow dungeons difficulty to be a bit easier.
[*]Fixed Vampire getting mana when not damaging foes.
[*]Fixed some log errors.
[/list]
